name: INDONESIAN RUMMY
description: Remi Indonesia (or simply Remi) is a popular Indonesian distillation of classic Rummy. It is a draw-and-discard game for 2 to 4 players, emphasizing the creation of sets (three of a kind) and runs (sequences). It features a unique scoring system involving negative points for 'dead' cards and bonuses for ending the game with a 'Remi' (dumping the entire hand).

content.text: Remi Indonesia (or simply Remi) is a popular Indonesian distillation of classic Rummy. It is a draw-and-discard game for 2 to 4 players, emphasizing the creation of sets (three of a kind) and runs (sequences). It features a unique scoring system involving negative points for 'dead' cards and bonuses for ending the game with a 'Remi' (dumping the entire hand).
Remi spread through Southeast Asia during the mid-20th century. While related to Gin Rummy and Loba, it developed a specific scoring flavor in Indonesia, particularly in Java and Sumatra.
Standard 52-card deck. Aces can be high or low but generally 11 points.
